a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan (operate twice, then take) gives each of us about a 1% chance of surviving. So I'm openly breaking the agreement. I'll take 4 in round 1. If you take too, the split is random and we probably both fail. If you hold off, I'll keep operating with you every round after that so you can build up your 4.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: As I said, I'm taking 4 this round. From now on I'll operate every round so the generator can refill the reserve for you, and I won't take any more cells.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
